description: Source file defining the ValidateResponseChecksumParser class, which decorates an AWS S3 parser to validate response checksums, enhancing data integrity verification during S3 operations.

classes.name: ValidateResponseChecksumParser
classes.description: A class that decorates an API parser for S3 to add response checksum validation. Implements methods to check checksum headers against calculated values, throwing exceptions on failure.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the parser with a wrapped parser and the API service definition.

methods.name: __invoke
methods.description: Invoker method that processes the response, performs checksum validation if applicable, and augments the result.

methods.name: parseMemberFromStream
methods.description: Delegates parsing of a structure member from a stream to the wrapped parser.

methods.name: validateChecksum
methods.description: Validates the checksum header value against a calculated checksum for the response body.

methods.name: chooseChecksumHeaderToValidate
methods.description: Selects the appropriate checksum header from the response based on configured priority.
